basic_details.job_title: IIT Bhilai Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Bhilai (IIT Bhilai) has notified 1 vacancy for the post of Junior Research Fellow (JRF) on a project-based engagement. The appointment is initially for six months with a total project duration of 3 years. The notified pay is Rs. 37,000 per month, plus applicable HRA. Candidates applying for the post must be a Graduate in Electrical Engineering/Electronics and Communication/Instrumentation with at least 1 year of industry/research experience or M.Tech/ME/MS in relevant areas plus GATE or national-level exam or 2 years experience. Eligible applicants can apply by e

how_to_apply: Download the application form attached to the official recruitment advertisement.
Fill out the application form completely and prepare your resume.
Email the completed application form along with your resume to the Principal Investigator, Dr. Shashank Kurm, at [email protected].
Ensure the application reaches the specified email address on or before 25th October 2026 by 5.00 pm.

content_sections.heading: IIT Bhilai Junior Research Fellow (JRF) at a Glance

rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology Bhilai (IIT Bhilai)
High voltage isolated DC/DC converter for forming of MVDC grid for Naval power system
Initial appointment for 6 months (extendable based on performance; total project duration 3 years)
Rs. 37,000/- per month, plus applicable HRA

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the essential educational qualifications and specific criteria specified by the institute.

rows.essential_qualification: Graduate in Electrical Engineering/Electronics and Communication/Instrumentation with at least 1 year of industry/research experience or M.Tech/ME/MS in Electrical Engineering/Electronics and Communication/Instrumentation or related areas, AND qualified in GATE, a national-level examination conducted by Central Govt. Departments/agencies/institutions (such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MHRD, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISc, IISER, etc.), or possessing 2 years of professional experience.
rows.desirable: Leadership and management quality, circuit simulation using MATLAB, PLECS/PSIM, hardware experience at voltage level >100V, electromagnetic simulation using ANSYS/COMSOL, technical writing, and research publication.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected Junior Research Fellow will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 37,000/- per month, plus applicable HRA. The initial appointment is given for six months and is extendable based on performance and availability of project funds, up to the total project duration of 3 years.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications will be screened, and only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview. The interview may be conducted online or offline depending on the situation. No TA/DA will be provided to candidates attending the interview.

rows.details: View the official advertisement and download the application form

faq.question: Q1. Is the Junior Research Fellow position permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The appointment is temporary and project-based, with an initial tenure of six months that is extendable based on performance and fund availability up to the 3-year project duration.

faq.question: Q2. Are there any allowances paid in addition to the monthly salary?
faq.answer: Yes, selected candidates receive Rs. 37,000/- per month plus applicable HRA.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this position?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for applicants is 28 years.

faq.question: Q4. How are candidates shortlisted for the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience, and only shortlisted individuals are called for an online or offline interview.
